title: How Levi Strauss is using AI for its DTC-first business model

title: Pacira brings Exparel DTC campaign to life with family-focused NYC event
summary: After several months of running the direct-to-consumer “Soft Landing” campaign for its Exparel pain medication via TV, web and social media spots, Pacira BioSciences has taken the marketing initiative from digital to IRL.
